items.title: India’s Bloom Eyes Southeast Asia and Twice the Rooms After $75 Million Raise
items.why: Mid-market hotel brand with limited premium card fit; monitor only if it moves upmarket.
items.summary_ai: Indian hotel group Bloom raised $75 million from Kedaara and plans to expand into Southeast Asia while doubling its room count.
items.take: Mid-market hotel brand with limited premium card fit; monitor only if it moves upmarket.
